name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 1.24 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
